name: Badge
summary: Small, non-interactive label for a status or category. The color carries meaning: Success, Warning, Error, Info, Brand or neutral Gray.
use: Counts or categories next to a title.
avoid: Clickable filters or values you can remove: use Tag.
figmaProps: Gray, Brand, Error, Warning, Success, Info
Label / Dot / Icon leading / Icon trailing
a11y: Color is never the only signal: the label says the status.
content: One or two words, sentence case.
Use the same words for a status across the whole product.
do: Link each status to one fixed color.
dont: Use red for something that is not an error or a risk.
